mapper.select: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', opened_at) AS day, COALESCE(SUM(gross_profit_tnd), 0) AS gross_profit_tnd, COALESCE(SUM(total_binance_fee_tnd), 0) AS binance_fees_tnd, COALESCE(SUM(total_other_fees_tnd), 0) AS other_fees_tnd, COALESCE(SUM(net_profit_tnd), 0) AS net_profit_tnd FROM p2p_trades WHERE user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.edinar.control.config.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'CLOSED' AND opened_at BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', opened_at) ORDER BY day

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', l.transaction_date) AS day, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount + COALESCE(l.fee_amount, 0)), 0) AS total_expenses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.type = 'ATM_WITHDRAWAL' THEN l.amount + COALESCE(l.fee_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS atm_expenses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.type = 'ONLINE_PAYMENT' THEN l.amount + COALESCE(l.fee_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS online_expenses, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.type IN ('P2P_BUY', 'P2P_SELL') THEN l.fee_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS binance_fees_tnd FROM ledger_transactions l JOIN cards c ON c.id = l.card_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.edinar.control.config.UuidTypeHandler} AND l.direction = 'OUT' AND l.is_void = FALSE AND l.transaction_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', l.transaction_date) ORDER BY day

SELECT c.id AS card_id, c.name, c.current_balance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.direction = 'IN' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_in, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.direction = 'OUT' THEN l.amount + COALESCE(l.fee_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_out FROM cards c LEFT JOIN ledger_transactions l ON l.card_id = c.id AND l.is_void = FALSE AND l.transaction_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} WHERE c.user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.edinar.control.config.UuidTypeHandler} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.current_balance ORDER BY c.id

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', o.order_date) AS day, COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_usdt), 0) AS volume_usdt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN o.quantity_usdt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS bought_usdt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'SELL' THEN o.quantity_usdt ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sold_usdt, COALESCE(SUM(o.binance_fee_usdt), 0) AS binance_fees_usdt, COALESCE(SUM(o.binance_fee_tnd), 0) AS binance_fees_tnd FROM p2p_orders o JOIN p2p_trades t ON t.id = o.trade_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.edinar.control.config.UuidTypeHandler} AND t.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', o.order_date) ORDER BY day
